name: EmbodiedBench
summary: 跨导航、操作、ALFRED 和 Habitat 环境评测多模态模型作为具身智能体能力的综合基准。
summaryEn: A comprehensive benchmark evaluating multimodal models as embodied agents across navigation, manipulation, ALFRED, and Habitat environments.
scale: 1,128 test tasks across four environments plus released model trajectories
scaleZh: 四个环境共 1,128 个测试任务，并发布模型轨迹
license: See repository, dataset, and simulator terms
licenseZh: 见仓库、数据集和仿真器条款
access: Benchmark datasets and generated trajectories available on Hugging Face
accessZh: 基准数据和生成轨迹已在 Hugging Face 提供
verdict: 覆盖高低层具身任务和细粒度能力诊断的综合平台
verdictEn: A comprehensive platform spanning high- and low-level embodied tasks with fine-grained diagnostics
wmNote: 多环境轨迹和统一评测可检验世界状态理解、规划与执行。
wmNoteEn: Multi-environment trajectories and unified evaluation test world-state understanding, planning, and execution.

evidence.sourceTitle: [2502.09560] EmbodiedBench: Comprehensive Benchmarking Multi-modal Large Language Models for Vision-Driven Embodied Agents
evidence.statement: Interactive testing tasks execute navigation and manipulation actions in four environments; retain as an environment benchmark, not a fixed dataset.
